blurb: Guests board a tiki boat for various themed cruises around Manhasset Bay and Hempstead Harbor. Cruises include breakfast, brunch, happy hour, sunset, and moonlight options, with opportunities to bring your own food and drinks. The boat serves up to 12 passengers in Port Washington and up to 18 in Glen Cove.
extraNote: All cruises have a mandatory 20% gratuity fee not included in listed prices except business lunch cruise which includes gratuity · Minimum 4 guests and maximum 12 guests for public Coffee & Pastries cruise · Inspiration Wharf 405 Main Street, Port Washington, NY; or 45 Herb Hill Road, Glen Cove, NY
